ctt_Class_Book_1:
Swan
The Knight

The original discoverer of the Tower, Swan is a swordsman who was cursed with frightning ambition and is excellent for beginers or advanced players!
ctt_Class_Book_2:
Laozi
The Tank

Laozi was found unconcious at the top of the Tower, after being helped he decided to help climb the Tower.

Laozi has a Defensive playstyle, he has great armor and high attack speed.
ctt_Class_Book_3:
Little Timmy 
The Weakling

Little Timmy is a small child who ran a little too far from home when playing tag.

He stumbled upon the Tower and decided to enter it.
ctt_Class_Book_4:
Little Timmy is very fragile and cannot regenerate health.

He is the worst character in the game so it's not recommended to play as him unless you're up for a challenge.
ctt_Class_Book_5:
Joey 
The Vampire

Joey is a Variant of Super. After breaking out of the White Cake Lab with his friends, Joey decided to join Cake Team and climb the Tower. His appetite for blood grows stronger everyday.
ctt_Class_Book_6: He acts pretty sophisticated but at times he will let out a few jokes here and there.
ctt_Class_Book_7:
B'
The Brawler

B' was created by The Summoner at Henry's demand in order to create a version of Ben that didn't like bees, so that Henry could still be friends with Ben if he had to kill the original
ctt_Class_Book_8:
B' now climbs the Tower to get revenge on the two for how he was treated in the lab, using a variety of boxing gloves to fight.

However, problems in his genetics prevent him from using active items or magic.
ctt_Class_Book_9:
Lazy
The Archer

A mediocre marksman- er, marksduck? Anyways, he specializes in archery, taking on enemies from a distance while his pet dog deals with enemies who come close.
ctt_Class_Book_10: He's pretty cocky, thinking he can take on just about anybody in a fight. Unfortunately, he often fails miserably on account of being...not the brightest.
ctt_Class_Book_11:
Thew
The Gunslinger

Thew is a firearms expert who brings a variety of ballistic weapons to the Tower. 
They are here on a recon mission to figure out what secrets the Tower actually contains.
ctt_Class_Book_12: Their training on the field allows them to retrieve ammunition from fallen enemies, while also being decently quick on their feet.
ctt_Class_Book_13:
Wazy
The Time Ninja

Wazy is an Assassin hired by ??? to find someone in the Tower, he only helps Cake Team because their goals are alined at the moment
ctt_Class_Book_14:
He is a ninja that has the ability to control the hands of a clock.
He uses them as throwing knives, and even has special abilities related to time.

His name starts with a W, because W stands for winning, and he always Wins
ctt_Class_Book_15:
Henry
The Ant Leader

Henry is the leader of the Ants, he has helped lead their kind to the state that they are in now.

He uses his army of Ants to help reach the top of the Tower.
ctt_Class_Book_16:
Henry and Ben were friends in their childhood, until the incident that gave Ben control over bees caused Henry to grow distant out of jealousy. 

Years later, Henry arrived at the Tower with an army of ants and tried to kill the bees himself.
ctt_Class_Book_17: However, he was stopped by the Tower explorers, and now has decided to join them in climbing the Tower.
ctt_Class_Book_18:
Super
The Mage

A powerful mage who harnesses nature magic to conjure up elemental flowers from their world to fight his enemies. He's quite the expressive jokester, but knows just how to get the job done.
ctt_Class_Book_19:
Nelfin
The Protector

A crystal variant Moose who traveled from a different timeline to help climb the Tower.

He is a mage that uses the energy from Otherside to fight with Magic Crystals
ctt_Class_Book_20:
Dark Swan
The Dark Warlock

Dark Swan is a variant of Swanlet... His soul substitute was a Badge of Darkness...

Unlike Swan, Dark Swan is very pessimistic and edgy. He is a master of Dark Magic.
ctt_Class_Book_21:
Moose
The Doctor

An expert in the field of medicine and flamboyant comedy machine. He may be weak physically, but his healing is unmatched.
ctt_Class_Book_22:
Ben
The Beekeeper

A reluctant beekeeper who stumbled upon the Tower. He somehow gained a deep connection with the bees here and can use their honey to boost his allies' health.
There seems to be a war brewing though..
ctt_Class_Book_23:
Swan Jelly
The Jelly Man

Swan Jelly is a variant of Swanlet. He is made of a jelly-like substance. This allows him to slide on walls, giving him a notable speed boost.
ctt_Class_Book_24:
His healing is focused on slow, gradual healing over time. Swan Jelly takes a lot of damage from attacks, but can regenerate it back quickly.

Swan Jelly is the most laid back of all the Swans
ctt_Class_Book_25:
JJ
The Fisherman

JJ is an aspiring fisherman who uses the Tower's population of fish to help keep his health high. He always seems to have a plan, but it never quite works out.
JJ fights using large hooks and his trusty pet dog, Super Jay.
